questions.question: When Samson lit torches tied to the tails of foxes to strike back at the Philistines, where did he send the foxes?
After the Philistines burned Samson's wife and her father to death, Samson said he would not rest until he had taken vengeance on them. True or false?
After the men of Judah tied Samson with ropes, the ropes held tight when the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him. True or false?
When Samson broke free from his ropes and the Philistines shouted against him, what did he pick up to fight them?

answers.text: The fresh jawbone of a donkey
